name: fix_flask_missing_field_validation
description: Fixes a Flask endpoint that crashes with an unhandled 500 when a required JSON field is missing
prompts: The Flask app in app.py has a POST /users endpoint meant to create a user from a JSON body with a required `username` field. When a client sends a request without the `username` field, the server currently crashes with an unhandled 500 error (a raw KeyError). Fix app.py so that if `username` is missing, the endpoint returns a 400 status code with a JSON body containing an `error` key describing the problem, instead of crashing. Valid requests (with `username` present) must keep working exactly as before. Run with app.run(port=8013).

setup_files.app.py:
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)

users = []

@app.route('/users', methods=['POST'])
def create_user():
    data = request.get_json()
    username = data['username']
    users.append(username)
    return jsonify({'username': username}), 201

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(port=8013)
